    fl = np.floor(h)

    hi0 = np.minimum(np.clip(hi0,0,None), nclip).astype(np.int64)
    r=np.arange(pool.shape[1])[:,None]; c=np.arange(pool.shape[2])[None,:]

    out = v_lo + (v_hi-v_lo)*gamma
